description: We are a team of four students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project, Earth Symphony, transforms Earth science data into sound through an interactive web experience. We are passionate about technology, space, data analysis, and creativity. We welcome motivated members skilled in web development, software, Earth science, data visualization, music, sound design, AI. Teamwork, curiosity, and creativity are what matter most. Let's turn Earth data into a symphony! 🌍🎵
